notes: User-authorized exploratory Qwen3-14B retention pilot, separate from the Qwen3-8B main research matrix. Eight of the 19 dev task families are sampled with random.Random(20261017).sample(sorted(families), 8), choosing variant _1 in each family without inspecting scores. One paired replicate seed, one fresh attempt per cell, no recovery, unchanged completion-v4 API prompt. All conditions share BF16, 32768 context tokens, 600 seconds per cell, 40 GiB peak VRAM cap and 6 GiB workspace reserve. Generation allows 4096 tokens per turn for reasoning. The 32 cells have at most 5h20m of task budgets, plus initialization and offline evaluation. This is a feasibility and variance pilot; eight tasks cannot establish a smooth or precise accuracy trend. Report all failures and uncertainty; do not pool with earlier configurations or use it to freeze the main experiment.
